svg.title: Critical checkout architecture review gates
svg.desc: An initial architecture with a cache, order database, broker and payment provider is reviewed. Blocking issues are stock authorization through cache, non-atomic order-event dual writes, and unknown payment outcome after timeouts. Capacity and tenant isolation need explicit evidence.
svg.text: Review invariants, not the number of service boxes
Blocking checks: atomic reservation, durable event, PSP reconciliation.
Capacity: peak arrival > service capacity implies growing backlog.
